title: Explain Your Experience and Respond to Follow-Up Questions
status: New proposed complete Lesson06 production script. Style and delivery conventions continue the accepted series.
continuity: L01 introduced shared discussion; L02 developed reasons; L03 listening and connected responses; L04 constructive disagreement; L05 task interpretation and preparation. L06 develops a truthful, specific account of personal experience and relevant follow-up answers.
boundaries: Seven independently editable sections, not seven additional courses.
An ordinary experience can be useful; the lesson does not require an exceptional achievement.
Fictional worked examples are visibly labelled and never presented as a real learner biography.
A planning aid is not an official marking rubric or a compulsory answer formula.
No fixed interview answer limit is asserted; editorial holds belong to the lesson.
One observed visitor and matching labels do not establish a measured causal improvement or success of the whole event.
Private practice remains unrecorded and unassessed; model viewing does not verify any real experience.
Silent English animation now; final localized coaching, recorded audio and measured alignment are a separate production pass.

sections.title: Choose One Specific Experience
sections.learningOutcome: Choose a specific, truthful episode with a clear action or decision to discuss; distinguish a useful experience account from a broad claim about personal qualities, without inventing achievements or disclosing private details.

sections.title: Make Your Own Contribution Clear
sections.learningOutcome: Make personal actions clear while preserving other people’s contributions; use I and we according to the supplied facts rather than inflating ownership or hiding an individual role.

sections.title: Explain Why You Made a Decision
sections.learningOutcome: Explain the information and uncertainty behind a decision, keeping the participant’s stated reasoning separate from later observations or unproved causal outcomes.

sections.title: Describe Results Without Overclaiming
sections.learningOutcome: Distinguish a completed action, a directly observed outcome and an unsupported wider or causal claim when describing an experience.

sections.title: Reflect and Answer the Question Asked
sections.learningOutcome: Give a reflection grounded in the case and respond to the particular follow-up asked, distinguishing future intentions from completed actions and unknown details.

sections.title: Rehearse a Truthful Account
sections.learningOutcome: Privately rehearse a clear account grounded in what is known, distinguish personal contributions and evidence limits, and prepare to answer a specific follow-up without inventing details.

sections.title: Adapt the Same Experience to a New Question
sections.learningOutcome: Select different relevant evidence from the same experience for a changed follow-up, without changing its facts, ownership or uncertainty.
